title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: c_{ij} is not specified; it must be the binomial coefficient (i+j choose i) for the PD relations.
The decomposition xi_i = A_i + B_i dX_0 mixes degrees 0 and 1. That only makes sense if phi_1 is an ungraded algebra map (dX_0 nilpotent), or if this is a sketch; it is left implicit.

The specific f = sum X_0^{(i)} X_1^{(j)} looks like a placeholder or generic element rather than a derived formula. As written it is not justified, and its relation to A_1 (a function of X_0 alone over S') is unclear.
The text explicitly says 'Je fais maintenant comme si...', i.e. the augmentation compatibility is assumed heuristically, not proved.

ideas.what: A PD-differential-algebra morphism out of the PD de Rham algebra of the affine line is determined by the image of X_0 (via A_i = A_1^{(i)}, d xi_i = xi_{i-1} d xi_1).
ideas.modern_name: Universal property of the PD polynomial algebra / PD de Rham complex (free PD-dga on one generator)

ideas.what: Unique factorisation of phi_1 as an augmentation-compatible automorphism psi_1 composed with base change of phi_0.
ideas.modern_name: Automorphism group(-scheme) of the PD de Rham algebra of G_a^sharp; semidirect decomposition over the base

ideas.what: Parametrising augmentation-preserving automorphisms by X_0 -> X_0 + f with f in a PD polynomial algebra.
ideas.modern_name: PD-formal automorphisms of the PD affine line (G_a^sharp)

missed.claim: Grothendieck studies the automorphisms of the PD polynomial algebra (the coordinate ring of G_a^sharp) together with its de Rham differential, as a parametrised group object over PD bases. This is close in spirit to the later description of the de Rham stack as G_a/G_a^sharp and to Drinfeld/Bhatt-Lurie ring stacks, where automorphisms of G_a^sharp and of the PD de Rham complex play a central role. The page is only a fragmentary computation, so the link is suggestive rather than explicit.
missed.quote: psi_1 est un S'-automorphisme de la S'-alg. diff. A_{S'} compatible avec l'augmentation
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It documents that in 1975-76 Grothendieck treated the PD de Rham algebra of the line as an object with a universal automorphism group over PD bases. This is a historical precursor theme to stacky approaches to crystalline/de Rham cohomology.

missed.claim: The computation of the universal augmentation-compatible automorphism (A_1 = X_0 + f) is left unfinished ('La remarque ci-dessus se prolonge —'), with f only guessed.
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Minor: a full description of the automorphism group scheme of the PD de Rham dga of A^1 is standard-ish but rarely written explicitly.

deep.surprise_reason: Routine PD-algebra bookkeeping (divided powers, PD derivations, factoring morphisms through automorphisms). Mildly interesting as evidence of Grothendieck's 1976 interest in automorphisms of PD de Rham algebras over PD bases, but fragmentary and not clearly new.
transcription_corrections: In the box 'xi_i ∈ S'{X_0}^+' the initial S is struck through and replaced by S'.
'Remarque On voit donc que (ici) phi_1 se met de façon unique...' is probably the reading; 'l'homom. ... prolongeant phi_0' likely reads 'l'homomorphisme de PD-alg. diff. prolongeant phi_0'.
'compatible avec l'augmentation' is a likely reading of the end of that sentence.
'A_{[...]1} = k{X_0, X_1}' is likely A_1 with a struck-out symbol before the subscript.
The neighbouring pages (numbered 49, 50, IX) are versos from the SGA 7 exposé IX typescript, unrelated to this page's content.
